lines.text: Did you know? Cept is Latin for take.
Quick quiz! Which means back plus take?

words.ex: Customs officers intercepted the shipment at the port.
A drinks reception will be held after the opening ceremony.

publish.title: Cept root: intercept and reception
publish.value: Cept comes from Latin "capere" (to take, to seize). Words: intercept and reception. intercept = inter + cept; reception = re + cept.
